_doc: Every contract copy this repo pins from a producer, and the producer branch it must equal. scripts/harness/pinned_contract_gate.py fails when a copy differs from the producer's develop. Refresh = copy the file, never edit it.

pins.note: Self-pin: this repo is its own producer. The projector's analytics contract (warehouse.slotting-optimization.analytics and its .dlq policy) is documented in this spec; the pinned copy lets the contract tests read the catalog without a build-time self-reference.
